purpose: Verify local official registry/cadastre evidence and inspect anonymous public map HTML/static JS/schema and geometry-safe routes for city parcel coverage.
scopeLimits: Inspected the local land office homepage, city Satu Peta HTML/client config, public Samarinda GeoServer WMS/WFS capabilities, BHUMI public map shell/client, and BHUMI default-layer metadata only. Did not request GetFeature, click-identify, or any BHUMI attribute record. BHUMI help explains parcel identification exposes property attributes; no such identify call was made.
assessment: BHUMI’s public metadata advertises a nationwide cadastral 2D layer, but the listed `/bhumigs/umum` service and tested standard WMS/WFS endpoints return HTTP 404; no feature geometry route or schema could be verified. Samarinda’s official city GeoServer WFS capabilities are public (205 feature types) but contain no parcel/bidang/persil layer; only a groundwater-tax layer contains the word “tanah.”
registryAssessment: The Samarinda Land Office is the local ATR/BPN office. BHUMI is the national ATR/BPN interactive cadastral map; its public layer metadata advertises the 2D “Bidang Tanah” layer and a GeoServer `umum:Persil` service. Samarinda’s own Satu Peta GeoServer is directly accessible, but its public WFS catalog contains no parcel/persil/bidang layer.

officialPrimarySources.observation: HTTP 200, 6,855 bytes; official Kantor Pertanahan Kota Samarinda office landing page.
HTTP 200, 1,590,789 bytes. Public city GIS uses the official GeoServer host and lists thematic city layers.
HTTP 200, 213,096 bytes; 205 WFS feature types. Name scan for parcel/bidang/tanah/persil/cadastral terms returned only a groundwater-tax theme (`pajak_air_tanah`), not parcel geometry.
HTTP 200, 13,552 bytes; public interactive map shell. Its static page bundle loads published default layer metadata from the public panel API.
HTTP 200, 1,545 bytes; one default layer record, “Bidang Tanah”, type 2D, vendor GeoServer, layer `umum:Persil`, configured path `/bhumigs/umum`. This is layer metadata, not feature geometry.
Official BHUMI help describes the interactive map as a public spatial-information interface integrated with ATR/BPN Atlas.
Official BHUMI help describes a “bidang tanah” map layer and identifies the information shown after feature click; no click-identify or property lookup was made.

privacy: No credentials, owner names, addresses, personal records, parcel identifiers, Khatian data, or property-detail lookups were submitted. Static schema and route names were inspected only where publicly exposed.
remainingUncertainty: Whether BHUMI’s `umum:Persil` layer is served through an alternate browser-only or proxy endpoint that returns geometry; whether its nationwide map layer has parcel footprint in the city. The city GeoServer catalog does not expose a local cadastral vector layer.
nextStep: Root review; no runtime source adapter or global registry/catalog change is justified by the verified geometry evidence.
